sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: points, suspensions and restoration
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Point values were taken from the two printed schedules, regular and commercial, and kept apart; a value is never moved from one schedule to the other [A02].
The offense table marks the racing rows with an asterisk that points to the vehicle-seizure note; that note was turned into a fact on the same page [A04].
A NOTE under the offense table says DMV must revoke for two years when the court finds a longer period appropriate, but it does not say which rows it covers; it was left out of the learner facts (verify NC-PTS-D-NOTE).
Statute citations printed in the point tables were summarized as the cited statute rather than copied, and court form web addresses were not reproduced.
Fees, the hearing phone number and payment options are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.

verification_debt.claim_text: The NOTE under the suspension table on physical page 39 says the division must revoke for two years if the court finds a longer period appropriate, without naming the offenses it applies to; confirm its scope from an official source before teaching it.
